children: US specialty materials maker's Q3 revenue rose 8% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Higher selling prices offset increased raw material and distribution costs
Eastman projects full-year 2026 adjusted EPS between $6.00 and $6.20
Company expects 2026 operating cash flow of approximately $850 mln
Eastman anticipates higher raw material and distribution costs due to Middle East conflict
PRICE INCREASES - Co said higher selling prices across segments offset elevated raw material and distribution costs
ASSET UTILIZATION - Improved asset utilization after inventory reduction actions in 3Q25 contributed to EBIT growth
SEGMENT PERFORMANCE - Strong performance in Additives & Functional Products and Advanced Materials supported results, while Fibers EBIT declined due to lower contract pricing and higher input costs
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 10 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialty chemicals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Eastman Chemical Co is $76.00, about 14% above its October 28 closing price of $66.67
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
